_doc: Server rule defaults. Override them in user://server.cfg (key: value) or point RuleConfig at an rAthena/Hercules conf/battle tree. Values are percentages: 100 is the Pre-Renewal baseline, so 5000 is 50x. kafra_fee is zeny per Twilight Kafra storage use (0 = free); rAthena Kafra scripts use their own fee argument.
